title: Compliance Term and Remind before expiry are in months
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A schedule open in the editor with a service form ready. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule (or open a schedule and Edit).
  4. ↳ Click Add service to open the service form.
  5. ↳ Turn on "Is this a compliance inspection?" so the compliance block shows.
custom_steps:
1. Read the Term control (its range and whether it is required) and try to Save without it.
  2. Read Remind before expiry: its default for a term up to 12 months and above 12; change it; then set it longer than the term.
  3. Set the same type with different terms on two assets (e.g. a bus 6 months, a tractor 12).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Term is in months, 1 to 60, chosen from a list, and required (without it a compliance service cannot produce a due date); the type fills in nothing.
  • Remind before expiry is in months, defaults to 1 month for a term up to 12 months and 2 months above that, and can be changed.
  • Remind before expiry cannot be longer than the term: a longer value is refused inline (e.g. "Remind before expiry cannot be longer than the 6-month term").
  • The same type may carry different terms on different assets (a bus 6 months, a tractor 12).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10560 (S3, Add a compliance inspection service); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S3; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R6: “The term is chosen on its own. The type fills in nothing”
  • S3-R7: “Term will be in months, from 1 to 60, selected from a list, and is required. A compliance service without a term cannot produce a due date”
  • S3-R8: “Remind before expiry ... It is in months, defaults to 1 month for a term up to 12 months and 2 months above that, and can be changed. It cannot be longer than the term; a longer value is refused inline: Remind before expiry cannot be longer than the 6-month term”
  • S3-E2: “A bus and a tractor may carry the same type with different terms, 6 and 12 months”
